title: Checking Sound and Action: Generative AI for Underwater Acoustic Analysis
review_scope: Automated consistency checks, page inspection, and separate agent critiques; no human-review attestation
editorial_changes: Operator scenario and stated/applied-setting anecdote introduce the problem
Contribution framed as controlled acoustic failure diagnosis and targeted interventions
Diffusion, masks, practice repairs, velocity prediction, and thinking allowance explained in context
Three acoustic examples emphasize what the measured changes mean
Conclusions identify concrete checks for future systems
Established algorithms and uncertain comparisons remain qualified
precision_checks: Gap RMS differences are attributed to the whole gap, not the 78 Hz tone
Step 934 is a threshold crossing, not exactly 1% signal power
Agents use recorded context; no integrated repair-to-agent experiment is claimed
New empirical findings are distinguished from established error-amplification mathematics
Declared retained prompts are evaluated-agent prompts, not a certified full Codex conversation export
